properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Horn follows the latched acknowledgment state.
A present fault cannot be reset away.
Every new event annunciates despite simultaneous Ack.
Fault disappearance does not clear the visible alarm.
Forbids spontaneous alarm or pre-acknowledgment on idle scans.
Preserves acknowledgment retention without requiring CompleteBehavior.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.Alarm: O[k].Alarm: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Acknowledged: O[k].Acknowledged: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Horn: O[k].Horn: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.first: k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation
atomic_propositions.qFault: {"kind": "previous_sampled_input", "source": "I[k-1].Fault", "initial": false, "update": "After EVERY scan k, including invalid/reset/stop, store I[k].Fault"}
atomic_propositions.qAlarm: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].Alarm", "initial": false, "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Alarm; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.qAck: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].Acknowledged", "initial": false, "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Acknowledged; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_SELF010(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
latched/ack/previousFault初值FALSE。Reset & !Fault时清latched/ack；否则Fault时置latched，若Fault新沿清ack、否则Ack置ack；否则旧latched且Ack置ack，其余保持。Alarm=latchedAfter，Acknowledged=ackAfter，Horn=latchedAfter & !ackAfter。previousFault每拍=Fault。
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Alarm=false, O_init.Acknowledged=false, O_init.Horn=false.
